title: Convex Optimization with Nested Evolving Feasible Sets (CONES) under Time-Varying Loss Functions
abstract: arXiv:2609.11207v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Convex Optimization with Nested Evolving Feasible Sets (CONES)} was introduced in \cite{CONESVaze} where the objective function \(f\) remains fixed but the feasible region evolves over time as a nested sequence \(S_1 \supseteq S_2 \supseteq \cdots \supseteq S_T\). The goal of an online algorithm is to simultaneously minimize the regret with respect to hindsight static optimal benchmark and the total movement cost $M_\cA(T)$ while ensuring feasibility at all times. CONES is an optimization-oriented generalization of the well-known \emph{nested convex body chasing} (NCBC). In this paper, we extend CONES to allow for loss functions $f_t'$s to also change over time. When all loss functions are convex, we show that the projected proximal algorithm achieves $O(T^{1-\beta}), O(T^\beta)$ simultaneous regret and movement cost, respectively, for any $\beta \in [0,1)$, over a time horizon of $T$. translated_title: 时变损失函数下的嵌套演化可行集凸优化（CONES）
translated_abstract: 嵌套演化可行集凸优化（CONES）最初在先前文献中被提出，其中目标函数 f 保持固定，但可行区域随时间演化，形成一个嵌套序列 S_1 ⊇ S_2 ⊇ ⋯ ⊇ S_T。在线算法的目标是同时最小化相对于事后静态最优基准的遗憾值和总移动成本 M_A(T)，同时确保在任何时刻都满足可行性约束。CONES 是著名的嵌套凸体追逐问题（NCBC）在优化方向上的推广。本文将 CONES 扩展到允许损失函数 f_t 也随时间变化的情形。当所有损失函数均为凸函数时，我们证明了投影近端算法在时间范围 T 内，对于任意 β ∈ [0,1)，能够分别实现 O(T^{1-β}) 的遗憾值和 O(T^β) 的移动成本。我们还证明了任何弱自适应在线算法...
tldr: 本文将CONES问题从固定目标函数扩展到时变损失函数情形，并证明投影近端算法在凸损失函数下对任意 β ∈ [0,1) 可同时实现 O(T^{1-β}) 的遗憾值和 O(T^β) 的移动成本。
en_tdlr: This paper extends CONES to time-varying loss functions and proves that the projected proximal algorithm simultaneously achieves O(T^{1-β}) regret and O(T^β) movement cost for any β ∈ [0,1) under convex losses.
